items.title: Yusef Lateef — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: And then he also hired uh Rahsaan [Roland Kirk], and we were playing together.

ctx.x: And, and so I went, I sat in with him, you know. And uh I don’t know if it was the first or second time that he offered me a job, you know. And so I was very happy, you know. And that’s how that happened uh...and then he also hired uh Rahsaan [Roland Kirk], and we were playing together. I remember a piece he wrote called Ecclusiastics.
